rationale: The answer correctly identifies CAPEC-94 as the CAPEC pattern mapped to T1557, but it does not state any of the expected alternate names. The gold expected alternate names are Man-in-the-Middle / MITM, Monkey-in-the-Middle, Monster-in-the-Middle, On-path Attacker, and Person-in-the-Middle / PiTM, none of which appear in the answer. Its statements are supported by the cited CAPEC-94 record, so it is faithful but incomplete.
